topic: Batch resize and convert images for the web

defects.location: SKILL.md How to use section, the command
defects.detail: Path uses backslash: 'scripts\resize.py' instead of forward slash 'scripts/resize.py'
The skill description and usage imply calls to ImageMagick 'convert' command (for image resizing and format conversion) but never list it as a dependency or requirement
Description states what the skill does but has no 'Use when...' trigger clause to indicate when an agent should invoke it
